verdict.rationale: Steel's docs describe a debug URL feature for human-in-the-loop workflows in which users can directly interact with and control browser sessions, which covers the core of taking human control. Embeddable sessions suggest a live view, but the evidence does not describe it in detail. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live-view streaming quality and latency, the mechanics of pausing the agent and handing control back mid-run, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
